details: Fintech company Block Inc., led by Jack Dorsey, increased its Bitcoin treasury by 85 BTC, bringing its total holdings to 9,117 BTC. This move positions Block Inc. as the 15th largest corporate Bitcoin holder and follows its recent entry into the S&P 500.
title: Jack Dorsey's Block Inc. Adds 85 Bitcoin to Treasury

details: Five major Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs), including IBIT, FBTC, BITB, ARKB, and BITO, collectively experienced $620 million in net inflows. This surge followed a security incident involving Coldcard wallets, with analysts suggesting investors may increasingly favor institutional custody solutions.
title: Bitcoin ETFs Record $620 Million in Inflows Amid Coldcard Incident

details: The US Senate has confirmed a delay in the vote for the CLARITY Act until after the August recess. This legislative setback prolongs regulatory uncertainty for the crypto sector, as the bill aims to clarify jurisdiction over digital assets.
title: Senate Delays CLARITY Act Vote Until After August Recess

details: S&P has given a top stability rating to BlackRock's tokenized reserve fund. This development enhances the legitimacy and institutional confidence in tokenized real-world assets, signaling a growing acceptance in traditional finance.
title: S&P Assigns Top Stability Rating to BlackRock's Tokenized Reserve Fund

details: Mastercard and Borderless are conducting trials for shared identity checks specifically designed for stablecoin transfers. This initiative could significantly improve the infrastructure and facilitate the mainstream adoption of stablecoins for various payment applications.
title: Mastercard and Borderless Pilot Shared Identity for Stablecoin Transfers

details: Crypto financial services firm Galaxy Digital reported a net loss of $85 million for the second quarter. This financial performance reflects a challenging period for the company amidst broader market conditions in the cryptocurrency sector.
title: Galaxy Digital Reports $85 Million Net Loss Amid Q2 Crypto Slump
